concepts.quote: You could write b as !(5 < n < 10)
concepts.why: The rewrite still uses !( ) and does not move the negation inside, flip the comparisons or swap && to ||, so it shows no De Morgan reasoning.
It uses the maths chained-range form 5 < n < 10, which does not compile in Java because 5 < n gives a boolean that cannot be compared with 10 using <.
